source.description: Don Pezet got his hands on the tabletop card game from Black Hills Information Security, Backdoors and Breaches, and put together a team to play. In this video, you can watch Don and his team take a security breach as the incident response team. Will they be able to stop it? Watch and see for yourself. Interested in getting a copy of the game yourself? It's available on Amazon at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B07Y3Y1XLP. Get access to more online IT skills and certification training from ITProTV.
